# The trusted global distributor and development partner for ingredients and specialty chemical
# solutions

At Caldic, partnerships come first. We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to enable
them to bring breakthrough innovations to market across the life science and material science
sectors. By combining technical expertise, local presence and a people-driven mindset, we go beyond
supply chain excellence to spark what’s next in healthier living and sustainable materials. 

[Explore our solutions][37]

## We go beyond distribution to co-create solutions that enable our customers to create entirely new
## product categories.
* ### Co-create tailored solutions
  
  We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to develop tailored solutions grounded in deep
  technical, market, and local expertise.
* ### Breakthrough innovations
  
  With over 70 application laboratories worldwide, our R&D teams co-create formulations that deliver
  superior quality and greater market value.
* ### Beyond supply chain excellence
  
  Our advanced supply chain facilities deliver custom-blended and packed solutions that reduce
  complexity, accelerate speed-to-market and get high-quality products production-ready.
* ### Global reach, local precision
  
  With teams in 44 countries, we combine global sourcing with local delivery to scale fast and meet
  market demands with deep insight and technical agility.

## Our Sustainability Report 2025 is here

Discover how we're turning our purpose, 'Because we care', into measurable progress across our
business. Explore our latest sustainability achievements, ESG initiatives, and the actions we're
taking to create long-term value for our people, customers, partners, and communities.

[**Read the report**][38]

[Cover page of the Caldic Sustainability Report 2025 showcasing the company’s sustainability
performance, ESG priorities, and commitment to responsible growth across its global operations]

## Solutions that go beyond distribution 

By connecting our market insight and entrepreneurial mindset with our deep customer understanding,
we develop tailored solutions across food, (bio)pharma, personal care and industrial applications.
From formulation to delivery, every detail reflects our care. With insight and agility, we help
simplify supply chains and unlock value at every step. 

[Discover our market solutions][39]

## Rooted in local teams, connected across the globe 

With teams in 44 countries and facilities across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific, we combine
global sourcing with local last-mile delivery. Our on-the-ground experts build strong customer
relationships and respond with speed, insight and precision. From sourcing and reformulating to
blending, labeling and resizing, our regional agility drives growth in dynamic, fast-moving markets.
We deliver fast, custom solutions - from bakery mixes to specialty pharma-grade solvents for nearby
hospital hubs. 

[Discover our global reach][40]

like our Caldic Academy. With global mobility opportunities and a trusted Speak Up culture, we’re
building careers that reflect personal goals and global ambition.

# The trusted global distributor and development partner for ingredients and specialty chemical
# solutions

At Caldic, partnerships come first. We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to enable
them to bring breakthrough innovations to market across the life science and material science
sectors. By combining technical expertise, local presence and a people-driven mindset, we go beyond
supply chain excellence to spark what’s next in healthier living and sustainable materials. 

[Explore our solutions][37]

## We go beyond distribution to co-create solutions that enable our customers to create entirely new
## product categories.
* ### Co-create tailored solutions
  
  We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to develop tailored solutions grounded in deep
  technical, market, and local expertise.
* ### Breakthrough innovations
  
  With over 70 application laboratories worldwide, our R&D teams co-create formulations that deliver
  superior quality and greater market value.
* ### Beyond supply chain excellence
  
  Our advanced supply chain facilities deliver custom-blended and packed solutions that reduce
  complexity, accelerate speed-to-market and get high-quality products production-ready.
* ### Global reach, local precision
  
  With teams in 44 countries, we combine global sourcing with local delivery to scale fast and meet
  market demands with deep insight and technical agility.

## Our Sustainability Report 2025 is here

Discover how we're turning our purpose, 'Because we care', into measurable progress across our
business. Explore our latest sustainability achievements, ESG initiatives, and the actions we're
taking to create long-term value for our people, customers, partners, and communities.

[**Read the report**][38]

[Cover page of the Caldic Sustainability Report 2025 showcasing the company’s sustainability
performance, ESG priorities, and commitment to responsible growth across its global operations]

## Solutions that go beyond distribution 

By connecting our market insight and entrepreneurial mindset with our deep customer understanding,
we develop tailored solutions across food, (bio)pharma, personal care and industrial applications.
From formulation to delivery, every detail reflects our care. With insight and agility, we help
simplify supply chains and unlock value at every step. 

[Discover our market solutions][39]

## Rooted in local teams, connected across the globe 

With teams in 44 countries and facilities across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific, we combine
global sourcing with local last-mile delivery. Our on-the-ground experts build strong customer
relationships and respond with speed, insight and precision. From sourcing and reformulating to
blending, labeling and resizing, our regional agility drives growth in dynamic, fast-moving markets.
We deliver fast, custom solutions - from bakery mixes to specialty pharma-grade solvents for nearby
hospital hubs. 

[Discover our global reach][40]

## Sustainability anchored in action 

Sustainability is built into how we care, innovate and grow. We help reduce environmental impact by
sourcing renewable energy, designing recyclable packaging and prioritizing safe, ethical workplaces.
We help customers reach their decarbonization goals by formulating products with responsibly sourced
materials, including bio-based options that support circularity. Smarter logistics and sustainable
design help reduce waste across the value chain. With a global EcoVadis Platinum rating at Group
level and 20 Platinum-rated entities, placing us in the top one percent globally, we are committed
to continuous improvement and long-term value creation. 

[Read about our impact][41]

## A place where you’re empowered to thrive

At Caldic, we empower people to shape their future. Whether you’re formulating new products, leading
supply chains, or scaling operations globally, you’ll thrive in our entrepreneurial environment. We
champion inclusivity, encourage innovation, and offer structured professional growth opportunities
like our Caldic Academy. With global mobility opportunities and a trusted Speak Up culture, we’re
building careers that reflect personal goals and global ambition. 

[Find your role][42]

## Want to partner with us?

By combining technical expertise, agile operations, and hands-on local support, we help our
customers unlock new opportunities and deliver meaningful impact. Discover how our solutions can
elevate your business. Let’s collaborate to achieve excellence together. 

[Start a conversation][43]

## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman.

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

From innovation to impact- see how we’re advancing solutions that power more sustainable products.

[Read now ][80]

## SHOKLESS™ systems for electric vehicle (EV) batteries
## What’s inside matters…

Developed to encapsulate EV battery cells, our portfolio of polyurethane-based SHOKLESS™ systems are
lightweight, shock-resistant, thermally optimized and structurally strong – supporting OEMs and
battery manufacturers as they work to enhance the next generation of batteries powering EVs.

opportunities today.

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

occupational and environmental health and safety communities. We have grown and expanded without
losing sight of our original goal – to encourage the interchange of experience among industrial
hygiene workers and to collect and make accessible such information and data as might be of aid to

To consolidate a global interchange of scientific knowledge supporting worker protection and to
prevent occupational and environmental illness and disease.

### ACGIH Mission

To advance occupational and environmental health globally by providing educational programs,
scientific data, and technical knowledge to Occupational and Environmental Health and Safety (OEHS)
professionals in the interest of workers and the public.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

# Reputed Petrochemicals Manufacturer in Chennai India

CETEX Petrochemicals is the only leading  manufacturer of **Methyl Ethyl Ketone (MEK), Secondary
Butyl Alcohol (SBA) and  Methyl Isobutyl Carbinol (MIBC)** in Asia.

[ OUR PRODUCTS ][45]
[ GET A QUOTE ][46]

#### VISION

To be the most admired Indian petrochemical company through world class performance creating value
for all stakeholders by innovation, customer centricity and exemplary levels of commitment for being
a responsible manufacturer.

#### MISSION

To be a sustainable manufacturing unit; focusing on high standards of safety, corporate governance,
social responsibility ,enhancement of productivity, quality & profitability, caring for customers
and employees, caring for environment protection, business ethics and cultural heritage.

#### VALUES

Our values are the back bones of our success. They define the core principles that guide the way we
work together that are key for us to succeed. We build lasting relationships with our customers,
partners and employees to position all stakeholders for success.

#### Safety

We are committed to providing safe working environments through continuous improvements in our
process, practices and behaviour.

#### Trust

We trust each other, collaborate, communicate openly and stand together to unify our people and our
business.

#### Quality

We ensure the highest level of quality in all the products we manufacture.

#### People Engagement

We are committed to create a challenging and enjoyable work environment that upholds the dignity of
the employees.

#### Integrity

We maintain a high level of transparency and integrity in all our transactions.

#### Innovation

We strive to improve productivity through a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and
sustained focus on elimination of waste.

#### Caring for Environment

We create value for our stakeholders in a manner that respects our natural environment and serves
the best interests of the communities in which we live and work.

## ABOUT US

### 30+ Years of Chemical Manufacturing Excellence.

CETEX PETROCHEMICALS LIMTED was started in **1990** for manufacturing 4000 TPA of Methyl Ethyl
Ketone. Over the past three decades, we have expanded to over ten products having a combined
capacity of around **50000 TPA**.

CETEX has built a reputation for excellence and reliability with its state-of-the-art production
facilities. We are strategically located near ports (**CHENNAI, ENNORE, ****KATTUPALLI**) which give
us a distinct advantage for efficient logistics. We are committed to delivering quality products to
our customers. Customer satisfaction is our prime aim and we make best possible efforts to achieve
it. We are the only manufacturer of Secondary Butyl Alcohol and Methyl Ethyl Ketone in this part of
the world. We believe in integrity through action and being transparent with our customers,
partners, investors, and employees.

Our environment practices are sound, and we make all the possible efforts in implementing
initiatives that contribute to the communities that we work in on a continuous basis. We have
established a wide marketing network that is operative in domestic and international markets. We
support and work closely with the communities around us. For us, giving back to the community is not
about social responsibility, but an integral part of us. 

#### CALL US NOW

Office Telephone: +91 44 24346727
Factory Phone: +91 44 25945150
Factory FAX: +91 44 25945161

#### COME VISIT US

Guna Complex, 3rd floor, Main Building rear side, New Door No.443 & 445, Old no.304 & 305, Anna
salai, Teynampet, Chennai - 600018, Tamilnadu, India.
Phone : 91 44 24346727

work together that are key for us to succeed. We build lasting relationships with our customers,
partners and employees to position all stakeholders for success.

#### Safety

We are committed to providing safe working environments through continuous improvements in our
process, practices and behaviour.

#### Trust

We trust each other, collaborate, communicate openly and stand together to unify our people and our
business.

#### Quality

We ensure the highest level of quality in all the products we manufacture.

#### People Engagement

We are committed to create a challenging and enjoyable work environment that upholds the dignity of
the employees.

#### Integrity

We maintain a high level of transparency and integrity in all our transactions.

#### Innovation

We strive to improve productivity through a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and
sustained focus on elimination of waste.

#### Caring for Environment

We create value for our stakeholders in a manner that respects our natural environment and serves
the best interests of the communities in which we live and work.

## ABOUT US

### 30+ Years of Chemical Manufacturing Excellence.

CETEX PETROCHEMICALS LIMTED was started in **1990** for manufacturing 4000 TPA of Methyl Ethyl
Ketone. Over the past three decades, we have expanded to over ten products having a combined
capacity of around **50000 TPA**.

CETEX has built a reputation for excellence and reliability with its state-of-the-art production
facilities. We are strategically located near ports (**CHENNAI, ENNORE, ****KATTUPALLI**) which give
us a distinct advantage for efficient logistics. We are committed to delivering quality products to
our customers. Customer satisfaction is our prime aim and we make best possible efforts to achieve
it. We are the only manufacturer of Secondary Butyl Alcohol and Methyl Ethyl Ketone in this part of
the world. We believe in integrity through action and being transparent with our customers,
partners, investors, and employees.

Our environment practices are sound, and we make all the possible efforts in implementing
initiatives that contribute to the communities that we work in on a continuous basis. We have
established a wide marketing network that is operative in domestic and international markets. We
support and work closely with the communities around us. For us, giving back to the community is not
about social responsibility, but an integral part of us.

# Home Page

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

Marine Deck Maintenance Ship Hold Tank Cleaning Rigs & Oilfield Water Treatment

### Featured Marine Chemicals

#### Oil Spill Dispersant

Rapid-action dispersant that breaks down oil slicks into biodegradable microdroplets for safer,
faster marine and industrial cleanup.

#### Air Cooler Cleaning Chemical

Specially formulated cleaner that removes scale, dust, and microbial buildup to enhance air cooler
efficiency and airflow.

#### Vapor Treatment

High-performance volatile corrosion inhibitor that protects metal surfaces in closed steam and vapor
systems.

#### Rust Stain Remover

Quickly eliminates stubborn rust stains from decks, hulls, and painted surfaces without abrasion or
corrosion.

#### Descaling Liquid

Effectively removes lime and scale deposits from boilers and coolers.

#### Heavy Duty Degreaser

Heavy-duty marine degreaser engineered to dissolve tough grease, oil, and sludge from engine rooms,
bilges, and industrial surfaces.

### Featured Ship Hold & Tank Cleaning

#### Slip Barrier Coat

Polymer based product, forms a protective, non-stick barrier on cargo holds to prevent material
adhesion and ease post-discharge cleaning.

#### RX Tuff High Foam

High Foam, higher power - designed for hold cleaning and general degreasing.

#### Lime Remover HD

Innovative, concentrated liquid product specifically engineered to attack, penetrate and remove lime
deposit accumulations from cargo and storage tanks.

#### RXSOL PCS Hold Clean

Effectively removes, Coal Carbon, pet coke and mineral & lime deposits from cargo holds and tanks.

#### Alkaline Safety Liquid

Non-caustic alkaline cleaner formulated to remove vegetable oils, animal fats, hydrocarbons, lube
oils, and petcoke residues from cargo tanks.

#### Iron Ore Cargo Clean

Concentrated blend of RXSOL proprietory formulated various products, which is specifically designed
for the rapid removal of rust, while providing phosphatized ferrous metal surface.

### Featured Rigs & Oilfield Chemicals

#### RXSOL RIG WASH

Emulsifier with powerful penetrating agents, corrosion inhibitors and surfactants. Quickly removes
oil, grease, gimres - best for cleaning double bottom tanks

#### Corrosion Inhibitor for Oil Pipeline

A highly effective, film-forming corrosion control agent specifically designed for oil and gas
production and transmission systems operating under sour gas (H2S) and acid gas (CO2) conditions.

#### Crude Oil Defoamer

Defoamer designed to effectively control foam in crude oil processing and refinery operations.

#### H2S Scavenger

Wide range of Hydrogen Sulfide Scavenger to elimiate traces of H2S fouling.

#### Scale Inhibitor

Specially designed to inhibit the scale formation in polyamide-, celluloseacetate- and
polyethermembranes with anionically charged surface.

#### Flocculants

Specialized well oil flocculant that aggregates suspended oils and solids for improved separation
and wastewater clarity.

### Featured Water Treatment Chemicals

#### Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors

Corrosion & Scale Inhibitors for cooling towers - multi metal protection, as well as for boiler
treatment.

#### Biocides

Closed-loop & Open-loop Biocides for broad spectrum microbe fighting.

#### pH Booster

Solutions to maintain desired alkalinity in boiler systems.

#### Sludge Conditioners

Heavy-duty cleaning of sludge from Boilers - reduces maintenance cost by more than 150%.

#### Oxygen Scavengers

Large range of Oxygen Scavengers for Boilers - eliminates traces of Oxygen from systems effectively.

#### One Shot Treatment

Use one shot powder/liquid treatment for your cooling/boiler unit which contains - corrosion/scale
inhibitor, alkalinity booster, oxygen scavenger, etc.

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail

WELCOME TO HLYCHEMICALS

 COMPANY OVERVIEW



Company Overview

Suqian Hengliyuan Import and Export Corporation, Ltd. is a leading enterprise specializing in the
international trade of chemical products. Established in Suqian, Jiangsu Province, China, our
company has built a strong reputation for excellence and reliability in the chemical industry.

Our Mission

Our mission is to facilitate global trade by providing high-quality chemical products and
exceptional service to our clients. We aim to be a bridge between manufacturers and end-users,
ensuring the safe and efficient transfer of chemicals across borders.

Products and Services

We offer a comprehensive range of chemical products, including but not limited to:

Industrial Chemicals: Raw materials for various industries such as pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and
manufacturing.

Specialty Chemicals: High-performance chemicals used in specific applications, including water
treatment, coatings, and adhesives.

Bulk Chemicals: Large-volume chemicals for industrial processes and manufacturing needs.

Quality Assurance

At Suqian Hengliyuan Import and Export Corporation, Ltd., quality is our top priority. We adhere to
stringent quality control measures and international standards to ensure that our products meet the
highest levels of purity and performance. Our dedicated quality assurance team conducts rigorous
inspections and testing to guarantee the integrity and safety of all our chemical products.

Global Network

Leveraging our extensive network of suppliers and partners, we are able to source and deliver a wide
array of chemical products to clients worldwide. Our strategic partnerships and logistical expertise
enable us to offer competitive pricing, timely delivery, and customized solutions to meet the
diverse needs of our clients.

Commitment to Sustainability

We are committed to sustainable business practices and environmental stewardship. Our operations are
designed to minimize environmental impact, and we continuously seek ways to improve our processes
and reduce our carbon footprint. We work closely with our suppliers and customers to promote the
responsible use and disposal of chemicals.

Customer Focus

Our clients are at the heart of everything we do. We pride ourselves on providing personalized
service and building long-term relationships based on trust and mutual benefit. Our experienced team
of professionals is dedicated to understanding our clients' needs and delivering solutions that
exceed their expectations.

Basil Oil is very effective in revitalizing dull hair and skin, while it is also used in treating

indigestion, constipation, stomach cramps and flatulence. Before final dispatch, it is checked on
different quality parameters by our experts to ensure its best quality. This oil's anti-inflammatory
property makes it an excellent skin remedy for irritations, small wounds and sores. Being a rich
source of vitamin C, it helps to maintain skin collagen and boosts skin metabolism. Mixing basil
oil, multani mitti, honey, lemon juice and applying it one face helps to prevent blackheads. Basil

# Omya ranked #7 globally in chemical distribution

##### Our combined businesses, Omya Specialty Materials and Omya Performance Polymer Distribution,
##### are ranked 3rd in Europe and 7th globally in the 2025 ICIS top 100 chemical distributors
##### listing.

[Read more][248]
[Omya Specialty Materials Hero Image]

# Omya Specialty Materials

##### One-stop shop technical solutions for customers worldwide through the global distribution of
##### minerals and chemicals.

[Learn more about Omya Specialty Materials][249]
[Science Molecule DNA Model Structure, business teamwork concept 270524519]

# Omya Performance Polymer Distribution

##### Your global distribution partner for high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and
##### rubber polymers and additives.

[Discover Omya Performance Polymer Distribution][250]

## Our business units
* [
  
  ## Omya Specialty Materials
  
  Global sales and distribution for a wide range of specialist minerals, pigments, binders,
  additives, and life science ingredients.
  [OSM header]
  ][251]
* [
  
  ## Omya Performance Polymer Distribution
  
  Global distribution of high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and rubber polymers
  and additives.
  [OPPD_Header_image]
  ][252]

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

[Learn more about innovation][253]

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

[Explore our story][254]

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]
[Innovation]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

[Learn more][256]
[Sunlight in the green forest]

## Join the Omya team

With 9,000 people employed across more than 50 countries, Omya offers exceptional career
opportunities to talented individuals with the determination to succeed.

 

If you have a passion for minerals and chemistry, and would like to be part of our team, we’d love
to hear from you.

[See our job openings][257]
[Career opportunities at Omya]

At Omya, we take a long-term approach to business, ensuring sustainability and growth for both our

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

[Learn more about innovation][253]

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

[Explore our story][254]

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]
[Innovation]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

[Learn more][256]
[Sunlight in the green forest]

## Join the Omya team

With 9,000 people employed across more than 50 countries, Omya offers exceptional career
opportunities to talented individuals with the determination to succeed.

 

If you have a passion for minerals and chemistry, and would like to be part of our team, we’d love
to hear from you.

[See our job openings][257]

## COMPANY

We, Royalchem（Anhui Royal Chemical Co.,Ltd; Nanjing Royal Chemical Co.,Ltd.）, and our
manufacturing company, Green Chemicals Co., Ltd,  are dedicated to our customers' success. We
provide efficient consulting, outsourcing, and technical solutions to enhance business operations,
strategy, and financial performance. 

 

Our R&D centers in Nanjing and Shanghai, with 30+ senior experts, drive innovation and custom
synthesis. With advanced production bases in Nanxiong and Yulin, we ensure high-quality, stable, and
safe products. Committed to innovation and customer focus, Royalchem and Green Chemical continue to
lead the industry, offering professional products, tailored solutions, and superior service to
support global market growth.

We are Manufacturers, Suppliers & Exporters

## Trusted company that deals in quality-made products

Sontara Organo Industries is a leading enterprise in the field of industrial and organic chemicals.
Founded in the year 1972, we are a Manufacturer, Supplier & Exporter of a variety of chemicals. The
company situated in Ambernath, Maharashtra (India) based partnership company is currently managed by
Mr. Mukesh B Parekh.We offer 1-Bromo-3-Chloropropane, 1-Pentyl Bromide, 11-Bromoundecanoic Acid,
4-Bromo Chlorobenzene, 4-Phenyl Butyl Bromide and many more chemical compounds.Our business
operations are led by an experienced team of professionals who make sure that all the activities are
performed in a systematic and best possible way. Further, they ensure our products meet requirements
of different industrial sectors.

Acetate, Isoamyl Acetate, 2-Phenyl Ethyl Acetate and more are carefully packaged into quality,
moisture tight material. Further, we give special emphasis on the storage of these chemicals. Owing

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools

your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

# Your Trusted Partner in Chemical solutions

Chemical distribution for all your business operations.

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.

# Transporte Especializado de Productos Químicos y Alimenticios en México

## Nuestra Empresa

Empresa mexicana líder en transporte de químicos en México, fundada en 1988 con más de 38 años de
experiencia

TRESAL es una empresa dedicada al transporte especializado de productos químicos considerados como
productos peligrosos y [materiales peligrosos][22], así como productos alimenticios, para lo cual
cuenta con una flotilla de unidades que van desde camionetas para el transporte de envases hasta
autotanques para transportar líquidos a granel en toda la República Mexicana.

[Más sobre nosotros][23]

TRESAL (Transportes Especializados del Altiplano, S. de R. L. de C. V.) es una empresa mexicana
líder en transporte químicos México, con más de 38 años de experiencia en el transporte
especializado de materiales y productos peligrosos, productos alimenticios y farmacéuticos a granel.
Operamos una flotilla de autotanques de acero inoxidable desde nuestras bases en Cuautitlán Izcalli
—zona metropolitana de la Ciudad de México— y San Luis Potosí, con cobertura en toda la República
Mexicana. [Conoce nuestros servicios de transporte químicos México][24].

TRESAL ofrece transporte **puerta a puerta** de materiales y mercancías peligrosas, y carga general,
a granel: cada embarque viaja en unidad dedicada —sin consolidar carga de otros clientes—, con
equipos especializados (autotanques de acero inoxidable SS 304 y 316L) y conductores capacitados en
nuestro propio centro licenciado por la SICT. Para un mismo cliente coordinamos una carga con varias
entregas.

## Servicios de Transporte Químicos México

Nuestras áreas de especialidad en el [transporte especializado][25] incluyen:

[Flotilla TRESAL transporte químicos autotanques en carretera México]

### Flotilla

En TRESAL contamos con una gran variedad de equipo para materiales peligrosos y alimenticios.

[Mantenimiento preventivo transporte químicos TRESAL]

### Mantenimiento

En TRESAL efectuamos un riguroso programa de mantenimiento preventivo de las unidades de nuestra
flotilla.

[Tortón TRESAL en operación de lavado interior en el centro de lavado de autotanques de San Luis
Potosí, con pasarela superior y semirremolque de acero inoxidable al lado]

### Centros de Limpieza

Contamos con centros de limpieza que se conducen con altos estándares.

[Monitoreo satelital unidades transporte químicos TRESAL]

### Monitoreo de Unidades

En TRESAL utilizamos un moderno Sistema de Rastreo Satelital.

[Ver todos los servicios][26]

Más de 38 años de experiencia en transporte químico seguro

### 100+ Unidades

Flotilla de acero inoxidable SS 304 y 316L para química, farmacéutica y alimentos

### 2 Centros de Lavado

Cuautitlán Izcalli y San Luis Potosí — sistema single pass de alta presión con agua caliente

### ISO 9001 Certificados

NYCE S.C. con acreditación EMA + CANACAR + certificación Kosher

### Cobertura Nacional

Toda la República Mexicana con monitoreo satelital 24/7 desde 1988

TRANSPORTE ESPECIALIZADO

TRESAL es una empresa transportista de productos químicos a granel en México con más de 38 años de
experiencia. Como transportista de productos químicos peligrosos y especializados, operamos
autotanques de acero inoxidable 304 y 316L para [transporte de materiales peligrosos][27] clase 3
(líquidos inflamables) y clase 8 (corrosivos). También somos transportista de productos alimenticios
a granel y transportista de carga general (glicerina, monoetilenglicol, vinagres, jugos) en toda la
República Mexicana. Cumplimos con los requisitos de Carta Porte 3.1 para químicos y operamos bajo
permisos vigentes de la SICT. Si buscas la mejor empresa transporte químico en México con cobertura
nacional, logística química a granel confiable y certificación ISO 9001:2015, TRESAL es tu
transportista de confianza.

acero inoxidable (SS 304 y 316L) transporta más de 60 productos químicos, incluyendo Clase 3

# Transporte Especializado de Productos Químicos y Alimenticios en México

## Nuestra Empresa

Empresa mexicana líder en transporte de químicos en México, fundada en 1988 con más de 38 años de
experiencia

TRESAL es una empresa dedicada al transporte especializado de productos químicos considerados como
productos peligrosos y [materiales peligrosos][22], así como productos alimenticios, para lo cual
cuenta con una flotilla de unidades que van desde camionetas para el transporte de envases hasta
autotanques para transportar líquidos a granel en toda la República Mexicana.

[Más sobre nosotros][23]

TRESAL (Transportes Especializados del Altiplano, S. de R. L. de C. V.) es una empresa mexicana
líder en transporte químicos México, con más de 38 años de experiencia en el transporte
especializado de materiales y productos peligrosos, productos alimenticios y farmacéuticos a granel.
Operamos una flotilla de autotanques de acero inoxidable desde nuestras bases en Cuautitlán Izcalli
—zona metropolitana de la Ciudad de México— y San Luis Potosí, con cobertura en toda la República
Mexicana. [Conoce nuestros servicios de transporte químicos México][24].

TRESAL ofrece transporte **puerta a puerta** de materiales y mercancías peligrosas, y carga general,
a granel: cada embarque viaja en unidad dedicada —sin consolidar carga de otros clientes—, con
equipos especializados (autotanques de acero inoxidable SS 304 y 316L) y conductores capacitados en
nuestro propio centro licenciado por la SICT. Para un mismo cliente coordinamos una carga con varias
entregas.
